summary: This is a routine Form 6-K furnished by Wise Group plc to the SEC, reporting its quarterly financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains a press release with key metrics such as active customers, cross-border volume, revenue, and guidance. There are no mentions of any special situations like acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. The filing is a standard earnings release and does not constitute a special situation event.
